parameter_rationale: Seasonal windows 45/60/90 balance relevance and sample support; sigma 0.75/1.25/2/3F spans narrow to conservative smoothing. Inner chronological day-weighted NLL selects one setting per model/vintage, on identical feasible cases. Wider window then wider kernel resolves numerical ties. Boundary selections are reported, not used to expand the grid after evaluation.
point_f: continuous translated-mixture mean = query raw center + average training residual; PMF median/mean/mode remain separately derivable
full_run_engine: scipy 1.15.3 scipy.special.ndtr with stable survival differences
reference_engine: S1 math.erfc integer integration; test/reference alternative must start a separate run
unit: one candidate/fold fit plus complete assessment-key forecast partition, committed together
outer_scoring: forbidden; defer until S4 comparison prediction seal
training_artifact: per-day/exact-issue residuals; training data, not OOF forecasts
execution: owner-run full history; bounded implementation probes first
